description:
Lambda, The Superintelligence Cloud, is a leader in AI cloud infrastructure serving tens of thousands of customers. Our customers range from AI researchers to enterprises and hyperscalers. Lambda's mission is to make compute as ubiquitous as electricity and give everyone the power of superintelligence. One person, one GPU.

If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us.


About the Role

Secures the power and land that Lambda’s AI compute growth depends on. Leads utility interconnection, power procurement, behind-the-meter generation strategy, substation delivery, site selection, and permitting, and is the executive-level counterpart to utilities, grid operators, regulators, and energy suppliers.


What You’ll Do

Power strategy, connectivity, and negotiations

  • Own power procurement and utility development strategy, including service agreements, interconnection requests, and capacity commitments.

  • Lead negotiations with utilities, energy suppliers, and fuel suppliers; model power cost, schedule, and reliability trade-offs.

  • Engage ISOs/RTOs and regulators on interconnection, tariffs, and load requirements.

Behind-the-meter generation

  • Set strategy for on-site and behind-the-meter generation (engines, turbines, fuel cells, microgrids) to accelerate schedules and improve resilience.

  • Lead fuel supply agreements and coordinate air permitting with Engineering and EHS.

Substations and interconnection delivery

  • Oversee substation and interconnection design, including coordination with utility-built facilities and owner’s engineers.

  • Hold the Connection Director and Substation Design lead accountable for cost, schedule, and reliability.

Site selection, land, and permits

  • Lead site selection and due diligence: power and land availability, zoning, entitlements, and environmental screening.

  • Own the permitting strategy and tracking across zoning, building, environmental, and air approvals; keep Project Controls and Construction informed of permit risk.

Team

  • Build and lead the multidisciplinary Power and Site Development organization; hire, develop, and set priorities and budgets.

You

  • 15+ years in electric utility, power generation, transmission, or datacenter power, with leadership of large teams or capital programs.

  • Direct experience with utility interconnection, substations, and transmission or distribution projects.

  • Executive-level experience negotiating with utilities, ISOs/RTOs, regulators, or energy suppliers.

  • Working knowledge of power markets and procurement structures.

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or equivalent; licensed Professional Engineer preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with behind-the-meter generation, natural gas supply, and air permitting.

  • Site development experience: land acquisition, zoning, and entitlement for large campuses.

  • Experience in multiple markets (for example ERCOT, PJM, SPP).

  • Master’s degree in electric power engineering or a finance/real estate credential.

Key Interfaces

Engineering · Construction · DC MEP Operations · EHS, Community & Sustainability · utilities, ISOs/RTOs, regulators, energy suppliers, landowners and local authorities

First-Year Success Measures

  • Power and interconnection roadmap for the site pipeline, with owners and dates for each site.

  • Behind-the-meter generation strategy and fuel approach defined for priority sites.

  • Connection, Substation Design, Land Development, and Permits roles staffed and each with a tracked pipeline.

Salary Range Information

The annual salary range for this position has been set based on market data and other factors. However, a salary higher or lower than this range may be appropriate for a candidate whose qualifications differ meaningfully from those listed in the job description.

About Lambda

  • Founded in 2012, with 500+ employees, and growing fast

  • Our investors notably include TWG Global, US Innovative Technology Fund (USIT), Andra Capital, SGW, Andrej Karpathy, ARK Invest, Fincadia Advisors, G Squared, In-Q-Tel (IQT), KHK & Partners, NVIDIA, Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, Wiwynn, Gradient Ventures, Mercato Partners, SVB, 1517, and Crescent Cove

  • We have research papers accepted at top machine learning and graphics conferences, including NeurIPS, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, and TOG

  • Our values are publicly available: https://lambda.ai/careers

  • We offer generous cash & equity compensation

  • Health, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents

  • Wellness and commuter stipends for select roles

  • 401k Plan with 2% company match (USA employees)

  • Flexible paid time off plan that we all actually use

Equal Opportunity Employer

Applicants are considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, age, sex, gender, marital status, sexual orientation and identity, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship, or any other factors prohibited by local, state, or federal law.
